title: 800 Series 36" Counter-Depth 4-Door Refrigerator
sub: Easy Clean stainless steel, recessed handles, water dispenser inside
lead: Bosch's 800 Series four-door: French doors over two drawers, a full 72 inches tall and a true counter depth for the look of a built-in. The VitaFreshPro drawer sets temperature and humidity for what is in it, and the refrigerator and freezer are each cooled on their own.

features.name: VitaFreshPro
features.line: A full-width drawer in two compartments, with pre-set freshness settings that adjust temperature and humidity for meat, fish or produce. By Bosch's figure, food keeps up to three times longer than in a Bosch refrigerator without VitaFreshPro. Results vary by food.

features.name: Two compressors, two evaporators
features.line: One cooling system for the refrigerator and another for the freezer, so each is cooled on its own.

features.name: Counter depth, full height
features.line: Seventy-two inches tall and a true counter depth, with handles recessed into the doors. It gives a kitchen the look of a built-in.

features.name: FlexBar
features.line: A storage bar that puts the usually empty space at the top of the refrigerator to work.

features.name: Water dispenser inside
features.line: Filtered water from a dispenser inside the refrigerator: touch the button or press the nozzle. Nothing interrupts the door fronts.

also: AirFresh filter and FreshProtect ethylene filter
UltraClarityPro water filter, first cartridge included
Wi-Fi with Home Connect, there if you want it: check and adjust it from a phone
